title: Update-submodules validation lacks its declared PyYAML prerequisite
title_de: Update-Submodules-Validierung verfügt nicht über ihre deklarierte PyYAML-Voraussetzung
protocol: GitHub Actions Update submodules read-only validation
affected_symbols: Run quick check without write permissions
observed_behavior: Authorized current-master workflow run 29981644356 completed resolver, candidate checkout, interpreter contract, and detached candidate checkout, then make quick-check failed because check-framework-fixture-syntax imports PyYAML while the job never installs the existing requirements-dev.txt dependency. The publisher was skipped.
expected_behavior: The read-only validation job installs a CI-only immutable PyYAML lock after its interpreter contract and before make quick-check, requiring the approved Linux x86_64 wheel hash while retaining contents: read, no explicit secret injection, and no publisher broadening.
impact: A valid Framework candidate cannot reach the normal candidate-PR publisher even after the Parent HAProxy fixture repair. The failure remains fail-closed and prevents publication.
preconditions: Framework candidate f73f8842f45318e2df8aff1d31855eeb7c20a22f differs from the Parent gitlink
reproduction: Dispatch update-submodules.yml on Parent master ad953cdcbc8c05ede519661ca56c03cf7b1ac7f3.
Observe make quick-check fail at check-framework-fixture-syntax with 'PyYAML is required for fixture syntax lint', then observe the publisher skipped.

evidence.command: gh workflow run update-submodules.yml --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector --ref master; gh run view 29981644356 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector --job 89124528892 --log-failed

root_cause: The validation job selects the repository Python version but invokes make quick-check without installing the repository's already-declared development dependency PyYAML>=6,<7. The fixture syntax checker deliberately fails when PyYAML is unavailable.
proposed_remediation: Install a CI-only PyYAML 6.0.3 hash lock in the read-only validation job after the interpreter contract and before make quick-check, with --require-hashes and --only-binary=:all:. Add a static workflow regression for the command, lock identity/hash, and ordering. Keep requirements-dev.txt as the cross-platform declaration. Do not change permissions, candidate execution scope, publisher code, the Parent gitlink, Framework, or MRTS.
acceptance_criteria: The validation job installs the CI-only immutable PyYAML lock after Verify Python interpreter contract and before make quick-check.
The lock admits only the reviewed PyYAML 6.0.3 Linux x86_64 wheel hash and rejects source distributions.
The static CI security contract asserts the command, lock identity/hash, ordering, and preserved topology/permissions.
Focused static tests, lock-metadata validation, and make check-ci-security-contract pass without a local system or user-site installation.
A task-owned Parent PR carries source, regression, English/German Change Record, and truthful evidence.
A later current-master workflow success is required before this finding is verified.
validation_plan: Validate the CI lock against official PyPI release metadata without installing a package locally.
Run make check-ci-security-contract and git diff --check.
Run a focused CI-supply-chain security-diff review.
Validate the exact corrective PR head and its hosted checks/SonarQube Cloud without claiming the master-only workflow as PR-head validation.
After a separately authorized merge, rerun Update submodules before verification.
legitimate_control_tests: Validator retains contents: read and no GH_TOKEN or secrets reference.
Publisher remains gated on successful validation and revalidates the official full SHA.
The CI-only lock matches the official PyYAML 6.0.3 Linux x86_64 wheel metadata while requirements-dev.txt remains the cross-platform declaration.
dependencies: Separately authorized future master integration and hosted rerun for final verification
residual_risk: Until the correction is merged and the master-only workflow reruns successfully, automated Framework candidate updates remain blocked. The CI lock intentionally fails closed if the GitHub-hosted Linux x86_64 CPython 3.14 platform changes until an explicit lock update is reviewed. Existing validation and publisher isolation prevent publication on failure; no security risk is accepted.
final_disposition: closed after https://github.com/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector/pull/92 merged to master as 95fb4917b63dd8a5c5973bb49fd955bd3d2b29a3; current master still performs the hash-locked install before the successful read-only quick check.
